source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "extreme speech" OR ("hate speech" AND (online OR "social media"))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"extreme speech" OR ("hate speech" AND (online OR "social media")),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("extreme speech" OR ("hate speech" AND ("social media" OR "online")))
